turns.text: Make one image, aspect 1:1, from this exact description: Create a photorealistic colour photograph of an older man, approximately 60–70, in a vertical, chest-up studio portrait. His torso angles slightly toward the viewer’s left; his nearly upright head turns subtly that way, eyes looking just left of the camera. He has an elongated oval face, a very high, broad, balding forehead, rounded cheeks, a substantial rounded chin, and a softly squared jaw. Light skin shows mottling, fine pores, forehead creases, deep vertical furrows between thick, low-set brows, pronounced crow’s-feet, under-eye folds, and lines beside the nose and mouth. His eyes are narrow, deep-set, and hooded. The nose is long and prominent, with a broad rounded tip and distinct nostril wings. Thin, firmly closed lips form a restrained, serious expression. Sparse, dark brown-and-grey hair sweeps loosely backward across the crown without a sharp part; longer, unruly curls spread around the temples and ears. Bushy grey sideburns descend along the cheeks toward the jaw; the upper lip and chin are shaved. Dress him in mid-nineteenth-century formalwear: black broad-lapelled coat, white high standing collar, white shirtfront, and a voluminous black silk neckcloth. Use soft directional light from upper left, gentle right-side shadows, and a plain medium-grey backdrop. Preserve the original monochrome portrait’s fine grain, slightly softened edges, and sharply legible facial texture while rendering natural, subdued colour.
